steps.title: Start a fresh chat for the task
steps.body: One task, one chat. Type /clear or press ⌘N / Ctrl+N in the Chat view. Old turns from other work cost tokens on every prompt and pull answers off course.

steps.title: Choose the role and the model
steps.body: Ask to understand, Plan to design, Agent to change. Leave the model on Auto for everyday work; pick a large reasoning model only for genuinely hard problems.

steps.title: Give focused context
steps.body: Attach the files that matter with #, use #problems or #terminalLastCommand instead of pasting output, and say what Copilot can’t see in the code.
steps.prompt: #problems Fix only these type errors. Don’t change anything else.

steps.title: Plan anything bigger than a small fix
steps.body: For multi-file work, ask for a plan, correct it, then implement. Fixing a plan costs a few lines; fixing the wrong implementation costs a whole agent run.
steps.prompt: /plan Move session storage from cookies to Redis. List the files to change, the order, and the risks. No code yet.

steps.title: Build in small, checked steps
steps.body: Implement one step at a time and have Copilot run the tests or build after each. Ask for short replies so the history stays small.
steps.prompt: Do step 1 only. Then run npm test and show me just the summary line.

steps.title: Review the diff like a pull request
steps.body: Read every change before you keep it. Check names, edge cases and anything you didn’t ask for. If you can’t explain a line, don’t keep it.

steps.title: Commit, then clear
steps.body: Commit small. Use the sparkle button in the Source Control commit box for a draft message and edit it. Then /clear before the next task.

decisions.title: The task has changed
signals: You are moving to unrelated work
Copilot repeated the same mistake after two corrections
Most of the context is about things you no longer need
decisions.body: Start fresh with /clear and a better prompt. Carry over only the decisions, in a sentence or two.

decisions.title: Same task, crowded window
signals: The context window control is past about half
Answers are getting slower or vaguer
decisions.body: Use /compact with a focus, e.g. “/compact keep the API contract and open issues”. Want to try a different approach without losing this one? /fork copies the chat instead.

decisions.title: It’s going well
signals: The context window has plenty of room
Answers are sharp and on target
decisions.body: Keep going, but keep prompts short and ask for brief replies so the window stays small.

checklist.label: Right role (Ask / Plan / Agent) and model (Auto unless hard)
Attached only the files that matter
Agreed a plan before any multi-file change
Ran tests or the build after each step
Compacted or restarted before the window filled
Two wrong answers? Started over with a better prompt
Read every line of the diff
No secrets or customer data in any prompt
Small commit with a message I checked
